scientific_limits.en: {"representation":"living-reconstruction","scope":"Whole-organism adult Stenopterygius quadriscissus reconstruction, principally anchored to SMF R457; not a specimen scan.","scientific_limits":{"en":"SMF R457 preserves a body and fin outline, but compression, preparation and missing tissues limit its fidelity. Body width and external eye size are inferred. Countershading and scaleless integument are supported at genus level by partial MH432; exact hue is unknown.
